attributes.context: The surrounding text reserves broad managerial policy rights to the Employer, including control of operations, staffing, facility management, and organizational structure, and states that these rights are examples but not limitations.

extraction_text: Matters of inherent managerial policy are reserved exclusively to the Employer. These include, but shall not be limited to, such areas of discretion or policy as the functions and programs of the Employer; standards of service and care; budget; utilization of new technology, equipment of methods; organizational structure and selection and direction of personnel.
